title: The Right To Travel With No Driver's License Motion To Dismiss
summary: Template motion to dismiss a no-license charge citing right-to-travel cases, lack of criminal intent and the license as a void contract.

assertions.quote: the license is not binding and cannot lawfully override my rights
I'm not a driver, not engaged in transportation, and not operating a motor vehicle
The courts have long held that the use of the highways in a private non-commercial capacity is a common right.
I am immune from prosecution [music] due to a lack of willfulness.

verdicts.note: Driving without a license is typically a strict-liability or general-intent offence, and mistake of law is no defence.

assertions.quote: Because there was no full disclosure, no knowing waiver, and no fair agreement

verdicts.note: A license is a regulatory permit, not a contract, and courts reject contract-based challenges to it.

assertions.quote: All rights reserved without prejudice. UCC1-308.
